newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Dovrat Shrem, Refco in pact.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Dovrat Shrem, Refco in pact.

text.p: Dovrat Shrem & Co said on Monday that it signed an agreement to cooperate with U.S.-based Refco Funds Holding Co in raising money for private placement by high-growth Israeli companies traded in Tel Aviv and New York.
"Refco's entry into Israel with Dovrat Shrem...will focus in the first stage on private placements," Israel's Dovrat Shrem said in a statement.

"In the future, the American company may well broaden its activities in Israel to other areas in which it specialises, principally derivatives and financial instruments in money, commodity and stock markets," it said.
Dovrat Shrem, with over $100 million in equity, provides investment banking services, including underwriting, fund management and real estate development.
